CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION rentlease_unfinished_posts.remember_publication()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
begin
 if new.status<>'draft' or new.published_at is not null or (tg_op='UPDATE' and (old.status<>'draft' or old.published_at is not null)) then
 update rentlease_unfinished_posts.records set ever_published=true where property_id=new.property_id;
 end if;return new;
end$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rotate_listing_edit_version()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
begin
  -- Opaque token changes even for two updates inside the same transaction.
  new.edit_version := pg_catalog.gen_random_uuid();
  return new;
end;
$function$
